title: Chordal directed graphs are not directed chi-bounded -- Section 3 "Further works": can the size of the (k+1)-dichromatic C_3 example be reduced?
central_question: The paper constructs, for every k, a digraph in the class C_3 (oriented; no transitive triangle TT3; no induced directed cycle of length >= 4) with dichromatic number k+1 and order n^(2^poly(n)) (doubly exponential), proving C_3 is NOT directed chi-bounded. Section 3 asks: can the SIZE of this example be reduced? The clean finite handle is the extremal function m(k) = minimum order of a C_3 digraph with dichromatic number >= k. The paper's construction is a doubly-exponential UPPER bound on m(k); the open question is the true growth of m(k), and in particular whether substantially smaller C_3 witnesses of high dichromatic number exist.

benchmark.description: The fixed yardstick. m(k) is computed EXACTLY on small instances: enumerate all simple graphs on n vertices (nauty geng), take every orientation (2^|E|), keep the C_3 members (oriented + no TT3 + no induced dicycle of length >= 4 -- pure combinatorial test), and compute the exact dichromatic number (SAT + lazy cycle elimination). m(k) is the least n at which a C_3 witness with chi_vec >= k appears; absence at n certifies m(k) > n.
benchmark.invariant: m(k) = min order of a C_3 digraph with chi_vec >= k
benchmark.upper_bound_construction: paper's (k+1)-dichromatic C_3 digraph has order n^(2^poly(n)) (doubly exponential); this is an UPPER bound on m(k+1). Any smaller C_3 witness of dichromatic number >= k+1 reduces the example size.
benchmark.oracle_api: scripts/oracle.check_construction(n, arcs); scripts/oracle.extremal_small_n(n, ub); scripts/oracle.m_of_k(k, n_max); scripts/core.{is_C3, has_transitive_triangle, has_long_induced_dicycle, dichromatic_number, acyclic_number, is_oriented}

open_crux: Determine the true growth of m(k), specifically whether the paper's doubly-exponential (k+1)-dichromatic C_3 construction shrinks. Concrete unresolved value: m(3), still pinned 10 <= m(3) <= (paper doubly-exp). ROUND-5 FRONTIER UPDATE: NO BOUND MOVED THIS ROUND -- the bracket is unchanged from R4. (B) LOWER-BOUND SIDE -- ENGINEERING TRACTABILITY FOR n=10 SOLVED, BUT THE BOUND IS NOT YET INCREMENTED. The n=9 enumerator could not even enumerate n=10 within 300s (the all_simple_graphs materialisation of 11.7M connected graph6 lines hit exit 124 before any scan started). R5 built scripts/m3_lb_scan_n10.py adding (a) STREAMING geng via Popen (bounded memory) and (b) deterministic disjoint --shards/--shard partitioning (resumable, embarrassingly parallel), reusing the byte-identical validated _orient + is_C3 + dichromatic pipeline from m3_lb_scan_n9.py. CROSS-VALIDATED at n=6,7,8 (reproduced n_C3=2186/25258/479168, max_chi=2, 0 mismatches) and the shard partition was independently verified DISJOINT + EXHAUSTIVE at n=7 (union==full scan). Only SHARD 0 of 200 has been run (1500 K4-free base graphs, 686258 C_3 digraphs, max_chi_in_C3==2, witness=null) => a SOUND PARTIAL consistent with m(3)>=11 but NOT a completed n=10 scan; the full m(3)>=11 conclusion requires ALL 200 shards (NO --limit) -- a ~100 CPU-hr sharded campaign -- and the SKEPTIC flagged that geng emits in increasing-edge order so shard-0/limit-1500 only covers the SPARSE band (median ~16 edges); the DENSE m=26-35 band where a chi>=3 witness would most plausibly hide is entirely UNSCANNED so far. So H7 is now 'running, tractability solved, campaign remaining' -- m(3)>=10 stands; m(3)>=11 is unestablished. (B-CLOSED) THE ASYMPTOTIC-LOWER-BOUND ROUTES REMAIN DEAD, NOW THREE: degeneracy-threshold (G11), clique-bound (G12), and R5's linear-acyclic-set / iterated-peeling route (G13) -- the proposed engine alpha(D)>=Delta+(v)+1 (free no-TT3 consequence, oracle-verified exact: K_{3,3,3} alpha=6/Delta+=3) gives only a CONSTANT bound on the SPARSE digraphs where beta*(n)=min alpha/n is actually minimized (oracle counterexample: disjoint directed triangles have Delta+=1 so the lemma bound is the constant 2 while true alpha is linear for an unrelated reason), so it supplies NO mechanism for alpha=Omega(n); beta*(n) bounded-below is exactly the dead G5 quantity, the route's asymptotic step is unprovable finite-n extrapolation (empirical_not_proof gate), and the claimed full beta*(9) enumeration was FALSE (both logs crashed/stopped at ~10-16% of 95915 base graphs). (A) UPPER-BOUND / SMALL-WITNESS SIDE: now even WIDER, two more operators dead. Closed families: G_2-substitution/products, Fano hypergraph realizations (G7) -- AND R5 confirmed the 'economical' single-shared-vertex (linear) Fano realization on its own 7 points is the SAME K7 (21 edges, all-degree-6, contains K4), 128/128 orientations carry a TT3, 0 C_3-realizable, fully subsumed by proved P3 (G14) -- complete-multipartite blow-ups/Turan (G8), directed-Mycielskian/iterated apex-cone (G10), AND R5's directed LINE/SHIFT-DIGRAPH iteration (G15) -- L(directed triangle) is a FIXED POINT of order 3 (no order-squaring), and over 19 distinct in-C_3 iterates (n<=40) max chi_vec=2; every iterate hits the same barrier (plain-line and ALL cyclic-shift variants exit C_3 via a long induced dicycle>=4; triangle-realized variants stay in C_3 but cap chi at 2). Net structural barrier (now spanning products, Fano/K7, blow-ups, Mycielski-cones, AND line/shift operators): chi-lifting in C_3 wants dense/complete LOCAL connectivity, which forces the forbidden TT3 (or a long induced dicycle). No live UPPER-bound/small-witness construction operator remains; the only honest computational frontier is COMPLETING the H7 n=10 sharded campaign (engineering-bound, +1 against a doubly-exp ceiling), and the asymptotic question is now untouched by ANY live computational lever -- it is a human-math gate.

live_hypotheses.statement: m(3) is small (say <= 20): there exists a C_3 digraph on a tractable order with chi_vec >= 3, far below the paper's doubly-exponential k=3 size.
live_hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: A targeted construction (e.g. a C_3 analogue of a 3-dichromatic gadget: directed-triangle substitution / blow-up that stays TT3-free and induced-long-dicycle-free) yields chi_vec=3 on a small order, certified by oracle check_construction. Refuted if every such small candidate is 2-dicolourable.
live_hypotheses.status: strongly weakened (R4): m(3)>=10 now (sound complete n<=9 scan) so any small witness needs n>=10; ALL construction families tried -- G_2-products (n<=13), Fano hypergraph realizations (n<=35), complete-multipartite blow-ups (to n=15), directed-Mycielskian/iterated apex-cones (n<=15, ~220000 C_3 members) -- cap at chi=2. No live small-witness construction route remains.

live_hypotheses.statement: The C_3 constraints (no TT3 AND no induced dicycle >= 4) are SEVERE enough that high dichromatic number forces large order, i.e. m(k) grows fast even if not doubly-exponentially.
live_hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: Extending the exact non-existence scan keeps finding max_chi_in_C3 lagging far behind n (m(3) >= some growing bound). Refuted by any small high-chi witness.
live_hypotheses.status: supported-strengthened (R4): lower bound rose to m(3)>=9->10 via the sound complete n=9 scan (max_chi_in_C3==2 over 12613784 C_3 digraphs); every construction family (products, Fano, blow-ups, Mycielski-cones) caps chi at 2. Caveat: a finite-n scan can only push the lower bound +1 per heavy run against a doubly-exponential upper bracket; H2 as an ASYMPTOTIC statement is unaddressed by scans (and the two asymptotic-lower-bound routes attempted -- degeneracy threshold G11, clique-bound G12 -- are now dead).

live_hypotheses.statement: Structured C_3 families built from the directed triangle G_2 (the only chi=2 C_3 gadget) by substitution/lexicographic-style products can lift the dichromatic number while preserving C_3 membership, mirroring how the paper iterates -- but with a far smaller order than n^(2^poly(n)).
live_hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: An explicit substitution of G_2 into G_2 (or a small C_3 graph) that the oracle certifies as (i) in C_3 and (ii) chi_vec=3 on order << paper bound. Refuted if substitution either breaks C_3 (creates a TT3 or an induced long dicycle) or fails to raise chi.
live_hypotheses.status: REFUTED (R2): lexicographic/complete-join lifts chi but always creates TT3 (leaves C_3); single-arc/directed-matching/chord-subdivided couplings preserve C_3 but cap chi at 2. Exhaustive >113000 C_3 members n<=13 all chi=2.

live_hypotheses.statement: Chi-lifting in C_3 is structurally incompatible with degree-bounded local couplings: any modification that raises the directed-cycle density enough to force chi>=3 also forces either a TT3 or an induced dicycle>=4, so C_3 witnesses of chi>=3 must be GLOBALLY structured (the paper's iterated mechanism), not assemblable from a fixed small gadget by local/product surgery.
live_hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: Any C_3-preserving local/product surgery on a chi=2 core keeps chi=2 (oracle). Refuted by any C_3-preserving local construction that reaches chi>=3 at tractable n.
live_hypotheses.status: supported-so-far (R2): every C_3-preserving product/subdivision tested caps at chi=2; every chi-lifter exits C_3 via TT3 or long induced dicycle).

live_hypotheses.statement: A SOUND exact non-existence scan at n=8 (K4-free underlying-graph prune + complete orientation enumeration, no min-semidegree restriction) will find max_chi_in_C3 = 2, giving the genuine lower bound m(3) >= 9.
live_hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: Sound n=8 scan (K4-free prune is lossless since every K4-tournament contains a TT3, but EVERY orientation of each kept graph must be enumerated, not just min-semideg>=2 ones) returns max chi_vec = 2 over all C_3 digraphs on 8 vertices. Refuted by any genuine n=8 C_3 witness with chi_vec>=3 (which would instead give m(3)<=8).
live_hypotheses.status: CONFIRMED (R3): scripts/m3_lb_scan.py 6 7 8 ran the sound complete scan -- 5606 K4-free base graphs x all 2^|E| orientations, 479168 C_3 digraphs on 8 vertices, max_chi_in_C3==2, no chi>=3 witness; cross-validated n=6/7. Sound lower bound m(3)>=9 (empirical, finite-n, not in proved[] per discipline gate). Lever discharged.

live_hypotheses.statement: A SOUND complete non-existence scan at n=9 (same K4-free-lossless + all-orientations recipe) will again find max_chi_in_C3 = 2, raising the lower bound to m(3) >= 10; the doubly-exponential paper upper bound means the bracket on m(3) is extremely wide, so each +1 from a sound scan is genuine but the scan cost grows steeply.
live_hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: Sound complete n=9 scan returns max chi_vec = 2 over all C_3 digraphs on 9 vertices => m(3) >= 10. Refuted by any genuine n=9 C_3 witness with chi_vec>=3 (=> m(3)=9, a small-witness upper-bound coup). REQUIRES a tractable canonical/C_3-pruned complete orientation enumerator -- the naive all-orientations approach at n=9 is far larger than the ~132s n=8 run.
live_hypotheses.status: CONFIRMED (R4): scripts/m3_lb_scan_n9.py 9 -p 12 ran the sound complete scan via an early-TT3-prune backtracking orientation generator (validated SET-equal to all_orientations' TT3-free set at n=5,6; counts reproduce 2186/25258/479168 and max_chi=2 at n=6/7/8). Over 12613784 C_3 digraphs on 9 vertices, max_chi_in_C3==2, no chi>=3 witness => sound lower bound m(3)>=10 (empirical, finite-n, not in proved[]). data/n9_result.json. Lever discharged.

This is the only live lower-bound lever after H6 discharged m(3)>=10; an engineering/compute push, not new math.

Refuted by any genuine n=10 C_3 witness with chi_vec>=3 (=> m(3)=10, a small-witness upper-bound coup). The DENSE band (m=26-35 edges) is where any witness would most plausibly hide and is the part still entirely unscanned.
live_hypotheses.status: TRACTABILITY SOLVED, CAMPAIGN REMAINING (R5): scripts/m3_lb_scan_n10.py now enumerates n=10 via STREAMING geng (Popen, bounded memory) + deterministic disjoint --shards/--shard partitioning (the n=9 script could not even enumerate n=10 within 300s); cross-validated n=6/7/8 (2186/25258/479168, max_chi=2, 0 mismatches) and the shard partition independently verified DISJOINT+EXHAUSTIVE at n=7. A dense-first or stratified shard ordering converts the campaign from 'uniform +1 lower-bound grind' into a TARGETED small-witness (upper-bound coup) hunt.

CONFIRM-coup: a dense n=10 C_3 digraph with chi_vec>=3 surfaces => m(3)=10 (re-checkable via oracle.check_construction). KILL (= the bound-side outcome): the dense band is exhausted with max_chi==2, after which the sparse band completes the sound m(3)>=11. This makes the same total compute also a directed test of H4's barrier at n=10.

graveyard.idea: G_2-substitution products (lexicographic G2[G2] / complete-block-join) to lift chi to 3 while staying in C_3
graveyard.kill_reason: Complete-bipartite block connectivity DOES lift chi to 3 but ALWAYS creates a TT3 (oracle: G2[G2]_lex n=9 has_TT3=True, is_C3=False); chi-lifting and C_3-membership are incompatible for this family. R1.

graveyard.idea: C_3-preserving sparse couplings between G_2 blocks (single-arc, directed-matching id/shift) to lift chi
graveyard.kill_reason: Stay in C_3 (or create induced dicycle>=4) but chi stays 2; exhaustive 511 symmetric bipartite patterns of G2[G2] all chi<=2. R1.

graveyard.idea: Randomized C_3-membership-filtered local search n<=12 for a small chi>=3 witness
graveyard.kill_reason: 4000 trials/n found best chi_vec=2, zero chi>=3 hits; reject-sampling C_3 yield collapses to 11/4000 at n=12 so n>=11 evidence is near-vacuous. No witness. R1.

graveyard.idea: Chord-subdivided 3-directed-triangle construction (each inter-triangle arc replaced by a directed-3-cycle through a fresh chord vertex) to reach chi>=3 in C_3 by construction
graveyard.kill_reason: Exhaustive sweeps n=12 (14400 C_3) and n=13 (98928 C_3) plus densest variants: ALL chi_vec=2; density increases that could raise chi instead create TT3 or induced dicycle>=4 (leave C_3). >113000 C_3 members, zero chi>=3. R1.

graveyard.idea: Pure acyclic-number counting bound chi_dir>=ceil(n/alpha_vec) to certify chi>=3 / drive beta(n)=min alpha_vec/n below 1/2
graveyard.kill_reason: Oracle-exact beta(n)=0.667,0.75,0.80,0.667,0.571,0.625 for n=3..8 (incl. sound K4-free n=8 scan of 479168 C_3 digraphs) NEVER < 0.5; count-bound yields only chi>=2 at all n<=8; beta is non-monotone (rose 0.571->0.625, min_alpha 4->5). Predicted beta(8) in [0.5,0.571] with alpha=4 is FALSE. Counting route provably too weak to reach chi=3. R1.

graveyard.idea: Directed-degeneracy / directed-2-core prefilter: restrict the n=8 non-existence scan to whole-digraph min(d+,d-)>=2 orientations to cheaply prove m(3)>=9
graveyard.kill_reason: UNSOUND for minimal witnesses. The degeneracy BOUND chi<=1+max_H min_v min(d+_H,d-_H) holds (0 violations n<=7), but a minimal high-chi witness need not be its own 2-core: G_2 (m(2) witness) has min(d+,d-)=1 everywhere and vertex-deletion drops chi 2->1; peeling drops chi in 14202/31410 C_3 digraphs n<=7. Pruned scan proves only the weaker 'no n=8 C_3 with min-semideg>=2 has chi>=3', not m(3)>=9. R1.

graveyard.idea: Realize the Fano plane (7-point chromatic-number-3 3-uniform hypergraph) as a C_3 digraph -- each line a directed triangle, shared points coupled via identification gadgets -- to force chi>=3 by mono-line argument
graveyard.kill_reason: REFUTED by oracle (R3). Vertex-IDENTIFYING realizations make the 7 hub points a K7, every orientation of which carries a TT3 (explicit 0->1->3,0->3), leaving C_3 (direct-hub n=7 and hub-14: n_C3=0). C_3-SAFE (non-identified copies) realizations stay in C_3 but the colour-coupling is too weak: single-arc (n=21), digon-free-pair (n=35), directed-3-cycle-bridge (n=35) -- ~23000 oracle-checked C_3 members ALL chi=2, zero chi>=3. The mono-line argument is also unsound for dicolouring once copies are non-identified (line-triangle no longer monochromatic on the SAME vertices). R3.

graveyard.idea: Blow-up / Turan-densification as a chi-lifter or as the seed of an asymptotic LOWER bound (blow-up-monotonicity lemma => 'densification cannot lift chi => high chi forces sparse-irregular => order growth')
graveyard.kill_reason: REFUTED (R3). As a chi-lifter: zero of 3308 in-C_3 blow-ups (n<=6) raise chi; every cyclic-tripartite Turan orientation is in C_3 with chi PINNED at 2 to part-size 5 (n=15); r>=4 cyclic orientation leaves C_3 via induced dicycle. As a lower bound: NON-sequitur on 3 counts -- (1) false premise 'only dense C_3 objects are blow-ups' (skeptic certified a 14-arc twin-reduced NON-blow-up C_3 digraph on n=7, chi=2); (2) wrong direction -- blow-up monotonicity is upper-bound-side and a minimal high-chi witness need not have twins; (3) 'densification cannot lift chi' does not imply 'high chi forces large order' (sparse digraphs can have unbounded chi); the paper's doubly-exp size comes from iterated substitution, not density. Promoting finite-n to asymptotic violates the empirical_not_proof gate. R3.

graveyard.idea: Literature-reduction: prove m(3)>=9 cheaply by checking that all published 8-vertex 3-dichromatic oriented graphs (arXiv:2201.13161) fail C_3 membership, replacing the full n=8 scan
graveyard.kill_reason: REFUTED as a reduction (R3). The paper's 9 explicit matrices (all chi=3, all have a TT3, none in C_3 -- re-derives m(3)>=8 from the literature) are a TOURNAMENT-CONTAINMENT cover (D_1..D_9 = 9 of 159 8-vertex 3-dicritical oriented graphs, not the full 3-dichromatic family). C_3-membership is NOT subgraph-monotone, so 'all 9 fail C_3' does not imply 'no n=8 C_3 chi=3 witness exists' -- the CONFIRM->m(3)>=9 branch is a non-sequitur. Benign corroboration of P3 only; cannot replace the sound complete n=8 scan (H5). R3.

graveyard.idea: Directed-MYCIELSKIAN / iterated apex-cone over a C_3 base (shadows arc-free, per-arc shadow orientation, per-shadow apex direction; iterate M on M(G_2)) as a small chi>=3 C_3 witness -- the one chromatic-lifter operator never tried (triangle-free-style Mycielski/Zykov cone)
graveyard.kill_reason: REFUTED by oracle (R4). Full family sweep -- M(G2) n=7; M(M(G2)) n=15; asymmetric/partial apex-cones n=15; full Mycielskian over every small C_3 base r=4,5,6 (n=9..13) -- ~220000 exactly oracle-checked C_3 members, max_chi_in_C3==2, ZERO chi>=3 witness (n=7 baseline reproduced: C_3=52, max_chi=2). Realizes the proposal's own KILL branch: the chi-lift (adding a shadow cycle) immediately forces a TT3 (has_TT3=True, is_C3=False, re-verified), exactly like products/Fano/blow-ups. Closes the last canonical untried construction operator as a chi-lifter; extends the 'chi-lift => dense connectivity => TT3' barrier to triangle-free-style chromatic lifters. R4.

graveyard.idea: Asymptotic LOWER bound via the directed-degeneracy threshold N(t)=min order carrying a C_3 digraph with dd=t (dd=max-over-induced-H min_v min(d+,d-)); conjecture N(t) super-linear/exponential => m(k)>=N(k-1) exponential via the sound bound chi_vec<=1+dd
graveyard.kill_reason: REFUTED by oracle (R4). The threshold is LINEAR, not super-linear: brute n<=8 max_dd=2 (N(3)>8) and a dd=3 C_3 witness EXISTS at n=9 (K_{3,3,3} orientation, is_C3=True via oracle.check_construction, dd=3, every vertex min(d+,d-)=3), so N(3)=9 EXACTLY -- N(1)=3,N(2)=6,N(3)=9 = 3t, firing KILL condition (a) verbatim and contradicting the predicted N(3)>=10. Doubly inert: the dd=3 witness has chi_vec=2 while chi<=1+dd only gives chi<=4, so the bound is loose -- even a (non-existent) super-linear N(t) could not yield a strong m(k) lower bound. The degeneracy route gives at best m(k)>=~3(k-1), no asymptotic gain. R4.

graveyard.idea: Literature-reduction to a directed-Ramsey extremal number: lemma L 'chi_vec(D)<=omega_underlying(D)-1 for all D in C_3', recast m(3) as the first failure of L, and mine high-chi-bounded-clique (Neumann-Lara/Harutyunyan-Mohar/Erdos) for an asymptotic m(k) lower bound
graveyard.kill_reason: REFUTED (R4). (1) TAUTOLOGY: K4=>TT3 (0/64 K4 orientations TT3-free) forces omega_underlying<=3 for EVERY C_3 digraph, so 'first K4-free C_3 chi=3 = m(3)' is just the definition of m(3) relabeled. (2) Lemma L is FALSE as stated (edgeless graph chi=1,omega=1 violates chi<=omega-1 at every n<=8) and gives NEGATIVE computational gain -- omega=3 is consistent with both chi=2 and chi=3 (that gap IS the open m(3) question), so omega yields ZERO pruning toward chi>=3; verifying L still needs the full chi computation plus an extra omega call. (3) The K4-free prune it 'introduces' is already deployed (m3_lb_scan.py / m3_lb_scan_n9.py). (4) Asymptotic non-sequitur in the WRONG direction: the cited literature gives existence/UPPER bounds on the min order of high-chi bounded-clique objects, the opposite of the needed LOWER bound on m(k); and omega<=3 captures only the weakest of the three C_3 constraints (drops the load-bearing no-induced-long-dicycle). Substantive consequence (no C_3 with omega=3 and chi=3 at n<=8) is logically identical to the already-known m(3)>=9 landmark. R4.

graveyard.idea: Asymptotic LOWER bound via linear acyclic set / iterated peeling: beta*(n)=min_{D in C_3,|D|=n} alpha(D)/n bounded below by a constant c>0 (engine: free no-TT3 consequence alpha>=Delta+(v)+1) => chi_vec<=log_{1/(1-c)}(n)+1 => m(k)>=(1-c)^{-(k-1)} single-exponential
graveyard.kill_reason: REFUTED (R5). The load-bearing asymptotic step (beta* bounded below for ALL n) has NO proof mechanism. (1) The sole structural input alpha>=Delta+(v)+1 is genuinely exact (oracle: K_{3,3,3} alpha=6/Delta+=3, K_{2,2,2} alpha=4/Delta+=2, C3 alpha=2/Delta+=1) but gives only a CONSTANT bound on the SPARSE digraphs where beta* is actually minimized: oracle counterexample = disjoint directed triangles (n=6,9,12) have Delta+=1 so the lemma bound is the constant 2, while true alpha=2n/3 is linear for an UNRELATED reason. So the lemma supplies NO mechanism for alpha=Omega(n). (2) Same free-lunch family as dead G11 (local no-TT3 consequence gives only linear/constant, never the global super-linear growth an asymptotic m(k) bound needs); beta*(n)=min alpha/n is verbatim the dead G5 quantity. (3) empirical_not_proof gate: the route's own ground_plan concedes it 'reduces to one finite, oracle-checkable trend' -- a finite-n extrapolation cannot be promoted to an asymptotic theorem. (4) The claimed full beta*(9) enumeration was FALSE: both logs (data/beta_route_n9.log, beta9_killcheck.log) crashed/stopped at ~10-16% of 95915 base graphs, so beta* is exactly computed only to n=8 (cross-validated 0.667/0.75/0.80/0.667/0.571/0.625 n=3..8). Even a clean n=9 CONFIRM would not rescue an unprovable asymptotic step. R5.

graveyard.idea: Realize the Fano plane as a SINGLE shared-vertex (linear) directed-triangle digraph on its own 7 points (claimed NOT K7, vertex degree 3, no K4) and SAT-search the 128 triangle orientations for a C_3 one with chi>=3
graveyard.kill_reason: REFUTED (R5). FALSE PREMISE + SUBSUMED. The claimed distinction from G7 ('NOT K7, degree 3, no K4') is factually false: the Fano 2-section on its own 7 points is exactly K7 (21 distinct edges, every vertex degree 6, contains K4 on {0,1,2,3}) -- the SAME underlying graph as G7's already-refuted vertex-identifying branch. Oracle ran the 128 orientations verbatim: 128/128 oriented, ALL carry a TT3 (0 via long dicycle), 0 C_3-realizable, MAX chi=None. These 128 digraphs lie strictly inside proved P3's exhaustive n<=7 all-orientations scan (max chi in C_3 = 2), so the advertised 'first exact exhaustive certificate' re-derives a tiny corner of an already-proved theorem -- zero new information. CONFIRM (chi>=3 at n=7) was impossible (contradicts P3); KILL advances neither bound. R5.

graveyard.idea: Iterated DIRECTED LINE/SHIFT-DIGRAPH operator L (Harutyunyan-Mohar / Bermond-Fraigniaud / Poljak-Rodl shift-graph) -- claimed to square order per chi-increment giving a single-exponential C_3 UPPER bound, with each line-arc directed-triangle-realized to inject cycles
graveyard.kill_reason: REFUTED by oracle (R5). (1) The core mechanism collapses: L(directed triangle) is a FIXED POINT of order 3 (line_arcs identical to seed), so the claimed polynomial order-squaring-per-chi-increment NEVER occurs on the C_3 triangle seed -- order does not grow, chi does not lift. (2) Over 19 distinct in-C_3 iterates (n<=40, multiple expanding seeds + cyclic-shift variants over Z_m m=4..8) max chi_vec=2, ZERO chi>=3. Every iterate hits the same barrier the proposal itself enumerated: plain-line iterates past ~2 steps AND ALL cyclic-shift variants (plain and triangle-realized) exit C_3 via a long induced dicycle>=4; triangle-realized line digraphs stay in C_3 but cap chi at 2. No m(3) upper-bound improvement; the line/shift operator joins products/Fano/blow-ups/Mycielski-cones under the 'chi-lift => TT3 or long induced dicycle => exit C_3' barrier (supports H4). R5.

discipline_gates.empirical_not_proof: Finite-n enumeration VERIFIES m(1), m(2) and the lower bound m(3)>=8; it does NOT settle the asymptotic growth of m(k). A small high-chi witness is a genuine upper-bound proof (an explicit certified object); a non-existence scan is a genuine lower-bound proof only up to the n actually scanned. No asymptotic claim may be promoted to proved[] from finite data.
discipline_gates.audit_not_redteam: Every load-bearing claim (especially any 'no smaller witness exists' or 'm(3) = X') must get a separate red-team pass: re-run the exact oracle on the boundary cases and attempt an explicit counterexample construction, not just re-read the summary.
